title: Repairing Harm (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to understand how their behaviour harms children and partners, and how to engage in meaningful, safe repair.
learningOutcomes: Understand harm in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise how behaviour affects children’s emotional safety.
Learn how to apologise safely and respectfully.

modules.title: Harm and Fathering
modules.content: Explores how children experience harm from fathers.

modules.title: Accountability in Repair
modules.content: Shows how responsibility supports healing and safety.

modules.title: Repair Tools
modules.content: Provides strategies for safe, meaningful repair.
